name: M23M
summary: M23M is a Leadshine split magnetic encoder family with asynchronous serial communication for servo motor feedback. This listing represents the manufacturer’s series, with electrical and mechanical options dependent on the selected configuration.

description.en: M23M is a Leadshine split magnetic encoder family with asynchronous serial communication for servo motor feedback. This listing represents the manufacturer’s series, with electrical and mechanical options dependent on the selected configuration.

sources.title: 雷赛智能-分体磁电系列
sources.quote: M23M系列磁编码器有以下特点： 1、RS485接口，双向异步串行通信通讯； 2、双向异步串行通信规则，单圈23位，多圈16位； 3、通信线缆最长可达50m； 4、严苛EMC测试，满足恶劣电磁环境工况； 产品优势
